provenance.source: labourmarket.ai production Postgres (project gorgitwvdzxbnaxhrsrw), read-only SELECT
provenance.supplier: Arbetsförmedlingen public job ads (CC0, attribution required, owner-activated 2026-08-09)
provenance.note: Every number in this file is a COUNT returned by production. Nothing is rounded, smoothed, or invented. Counts go stale — regenerate before any reuse.

honesty.classification: Only 17,217 of 41,461 rows (41.5%) carry a profession_slug. EVERY profession count in this file is a count of the CLASSIFIED subset and must be rendered as such — never as a share of the whole inventory.
honesty.geocoding: lat/lng is NULL on 100% of rows. The platform holds no vacancy coordinates. City-level placement in any visualization is derived from the city NAME only; a pin is a city, never a workplace.
honesty.categorizationVersion: 41,297 rows are transform_version vacancy-arbetsformedlingen-v2. 164 rows remain v1; pre-v2 profession slugs are known-polluted and are excluded from every profession figure here.
honesty.employers: employer_name is the raw supplier string. No employer is named anywhere in the prototypes — only counted.

city.name: Göteborg
city.latLngSource: Geographic coordinate of the CITY (public knowledge), used to place the camera. NOT derived from vacancy data — vacancies carry no coordinates.

criteria.professionInteraction: highest profession evenness among high-volume cities: 0.841 (Stockholm 0.815); 17 professions with >=20 active, 12 with >=50
criteria.territory: working river port, shipyard cranes, Göta älv, Ringön industry — real economic activity is visible in a real establishing frame
criteria.journalToMatching: the chain professions all carry real catalogue skills in production (profession_skills)
criteria.cinematic: one continuous geography from river mouth to city block; no impossible adjacency needed

runnersUp.rejectedBecause: largest volume, but care+education and services concentrate 47% of the classified subset — a weaker economic-chain demonstration; also the owner reference frame, so a second city proves the engine is not tied to one plate
best evenness but only 3 professions above 50 — the chain breaks

chain.note: The Göteborg economic chain the flagship camera follows. Each link is a real active-vacancy count for city='Göteborg' in the classified v2 subset.

professionSkills.note: Real rows from production professions x profession_skills x skills. These are the canonical skill slugs the one match engine (lib/market/fit.ts) computes over.
